data.narrative:
Newspace Research is a Series B–stage defense and security company that has raised $73.2M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 10 peers: 2 publicly listed firms (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies in the same sector and stage, including Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Defense Unicorns ($1.0B), and Heven AeroTech ($1.0B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses a 1.9x multiplier on the $73M total raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $139M. The peer-median method references six same-sector, same-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.1B and a range of $300M to $3.0B. This wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in business scale and market position within the defense tech cohort.

The triangulated analysis produces a valuation range of $118M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $632M. The significant gap between stage-progression ($139M) and peer-median ($1.1B) reflects uncertainty around Newspace's relative competitive position and revenue maturity versus established peers. Key drivers of variance include revenue scale, customer concentration, and technology differentiation within the defense sector. Resolution of these factors through diligence on customer traction and unit economics will be critical to narrowing the range.
